system.description:
Fire and sunlight still burn you, but not with the hideous intensity with which they affect other Cainites. When you suffer aggravated damage, perform a Simple Test. If you win, one level of the damage taken is considered lethal rather than aggravated. You may spend a Stamina-related Physical Trait before the test to win on a tie.

Using Resilience is reflexive and does not count as an action. You may only use Resilience once for a given source of damage.
